origin.title: A University Spin-off with Institutional Backing
origin.description: Deepvac originated as a spin-off project at Leibniz University Hannover and develops its thermal vacuum systems on the university's mechanical engineering campus in Garbsen. The company is supported by the EXIST founder grant of the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy, co-funded by the European Union.
